chunks: From him, from Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad Al-Qati, from Ali ibn Hatim, from Muhammad ibn Marwan, from Ubayd ibn Yahya Al-Thawri, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (peace be upon him).
Regarding His saying, Exalted is He: 'And We desired to bestow a favor upon those who were deemed weak in the land, and to make them the Imams, and to make them the heirs...'
He said: They are the Family of Muhammad. Allah will raise their Mahdi after their distress, so He will honor them and disgrace their enemy.
ai.seo_question: Who are the 'weak ones' in Surah Al-Qasas verse 5 according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam Ali (AS) interprets the 'weak' in Quran 28:5 as the Ahl al-Bayt, linking their historical oppression to the eschatological rise of Imam al-Mahdi. This exegesis underscores the Shia belief that divine promise ensures the ultimate vindication and leadership of the Prophet’s family, transforming their perceived weakness into enduring authority over the earth.
